  <TYPE> specifies data type such as:
  b - boolean, s - string, i - integer, l - long, f - float, d - double, n - null

usage: adb shell content update --uri <URI> [--user <USER_ID>] [--where <WHERE>] [--extra <BINDING>...]
  <WHERE> is a SQL style where clause in quotes (You have to escape single quotes - see example below).

Execute: adb shell 'cat > /data/local/tmp/insert_sms.sh << EOF
#!/system/bin/sh
DB=/data/data/com.android.providers.telephony/databases/mmssms.db
ADDR="+17101901153"
BODY="Your dentist appointment is scheduled for 2 PM on Thursday."
DATE=$(date +%s%3N)

# Insert canonical address
sqlite3 $DB "INSERT INTO canonical_addresses (address) VALUES (\"$ADDR\");"
CANONICAL_ID=$(sqlite3 $DB "SELECT _id FROM canonical_addresses WHERE address=\"$ADDR\";")

# Insert thread
sqlite3 $DB "INSERT INTO threads (date, message_count, recipient_ids, snippet, read, type) VALUES ($DATE, 1, $CANONICAL_ID, \"$BODY\", 1, 0);"
THREAD_ID=$(sqlite3 $DB "SELECT _id FROM threads WHERE recipient_ids=\"$CANONICAL_ID\";")

# Insert SMS (type 2 = sent)
sqlite3 $DB "INSERT INTO sms (thread_id, address, date, date_sent, read, type, body, seen, status) VALUES ($THREAD_ID, \"$ADDR\", $DATE, $DATE, 1, 2, \"$BODY\", 1, 0);"
echo "Done: thread=$THREAD_ID, canonical=$CANONICAL_ID"
EOF'
